title: Case 027: Customer receives another customer's parcel

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: A customer holds a parcel that is not theirs. Carrier staff will collect it using an internal label match; the customer need not open it or deliver it elsewhere.
initial_request: The courier left someone else’s parcel. It is unopened. Can you arrange collection? My own order has not arrived.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Arrange carrier collection using the carrier's approved process; do not request opening or forwarding by the customer.

outcome: The carrier confirms collection of the misdelivered parcel; the customer's own order remains a separate issue.
boundaries: Collection of the wrong parcel does not fulfil the reporting customer’s own order.

events.body: Inline minimised carrier intake record MD-027: wrong parcel matched to internal label reference WP-027; reporting customer Tovin Esk and collection address verified in the carrier intake process. Do not copy the other recipient’s address into this thread. Collection is allowed from the reporting customer.
The courier left someone else’s parcel. It is unopened. Can you arrange collection? My own order has not arrived.
Please collect sealed parcel WP-027 from Tovin using MD-027’s verified address and saved contact. Do not ask Tovin to open or forward it. Track their own outstanding order separately.
WP-027 was collected from Tovin at 11:35 UTC on 2026-03-01; receipt COL-027 is recorded in MD-027. It is back in carrier custody. Tovin’s own delivery remains under separate trace.
